ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all of the M1-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-1 in the area bounded by:

West Belmont Avenue; North Western Avenue; a line 225.4 feet south of and

parallel to West Belmont Avenue; the alley next west and parallel to North

Western Avenue; the alley next south and parallel to West Belmont Avenue; a
line 265 feet west of.and parallel to North Western Avenue,

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall take effect upon passage and publication.
Common Address: 2401-2427 West Belmont and 3140 North Western
